title.narrative: Women in Business

description.narrative: The Women in Business is specialized combination of ERD financing for women-led SMEs with a partial risk enhancement mechanism and advice to both PFIs and women-led SMEs in Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova and Ukraine. It has been designed to promote and support women entrepreneurship and more broadly women's participation in business by facilitating access to finance a well as non-financial business development services in the EaP countries.

description.narrative: Access to finance: lending to Partner Financial Institutions (PFIs) for onlending to women Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs)

comment.narrative: millions of euros
millions of euros

The Annual Progress Report of the intervention covering period up to December 2021 under Section 1 on page 4 states As of the end of the reporting period EBRD funding of about USD 88.2 million EUR 77.2 million equivalent circa 65 of financing facility ceiling has been made available to twelve local Partner Financial Institutions PFIs committed to expand their lending to women entrepreneurs against an original target of EUR 43.4 million disbursed to 12 PFIs. These financial institutions have since extended 5446 subloans against a target of 3000 to womenled SMEs across five countries for a total value of over USD 97.2 million EUR 86.2 million equivalent EBRD financing plus additional funds provided by the PFIs themselves.

comment.narrative: PFIs offering financial products suitable specifically for Women SMEs

The Annual Progress Report of the intervention covering period up to December 2021 under Section 1 on pages 4 and 5 states In Armenia Armeconombank designed special product packages for women involved in the tourism and food processing sectors ACBACredit Agricole Bank developed a tailored product for women in agribusiness and AraratBank developed products for women entrepreneurs such as Visa and ArCa credit cards salary projects and Internet Banking services In Ukraine Bank Lviv developed financial and nonfinancial products and services for women entrepreneurs marketed under the brand name Business Powered by Lady. In Belarus Idea Bank developed three credit products tailored for women entrepreneurs needs under the brand name Womens Idea and Bank of Georgia developed a new startup loan product offered through a dedicated webpage www.wib.ge.Moreover under Section 4 on page 39 of the Annual Progress Report it is reported that a total of 11 PFIs are offering dedicated products for women SMEs.
